headline_item.title_zh: AI编程智能体实测：模拟环境任务完成率不足一成
headline_item.title_en: AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 研究显示，尽管AI编程智能体在SWE-bench等基准测试中表现优异，但在集成项目协作流程的模拟工作环境中，任务成功率低于10%
headline_item.event_summary_en: In a simulated software development environment featuring project boards, chat logs, and collaborative workflows, leading models like GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 achieved a task completion rate of less than 10%. The findings highlight a critical performance gap between high scores on isolated code benchmarks and the requirements of complex, collaborative system engineering.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Anthropic（Claude模型开发方）、OpenAI（GPT系列模型开发方）在集成化模拟软件开发工作环境：前沿模型在复杂系统工程任务中的实测成功率低于10%
【起因与机理】当前评估指标与真实复杂工作流之间存在显著的环境偏差
【关键数据与实测】在包含项目看板、聊天记录及多角色协作的模拟软件开发环境实测中，即使是GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5.5等前沿模型，在处理完整开发任务时的成功率亦不足10%。
【各方立场与态度】软件工程中AI智能体的实际交付门槛远高于孤立编码。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Anthropic and OpenAI: Frontier models achieved less than 10% task completion in complex workflows
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Significant discrepancy between synthetic benchmarks and real-world system complexity

[Key Metrics] In a simulated software development environment featuring project boards, chat logs, and collaborative workflows, leading models like GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 achieved a task completion rate of less than 10%.
[Key Position & Outlook] Actual delivery barriers for AI coding agents exceed isolated code generation.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 现有基准测试正陷入过度拟合的陷阱，由于缺乏对多轮长逻辑协作、沟通成本及系统性上下文的覆盖，导致模型在实验室环境的卓越表现无法转化为生产力。企业在部署AI智能体时应摒弃对基准分数的盲目崇拜，转而建立基于内部长上下文工作流的效能审计框架。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: Existing benchmarks are falling into an overfitting trap, failing to capture the complexity of multi-turn logic, communication overhead, and systemic context required for production. Enterprises must pivot away from benchmark-driven procurement and instead establish performance audit frameworks grounded in their specific long-context operational workflows.

headlines.title_zh: 硅谷AI产业新共识：“品味”成为对抗算法同质化的最后壁垒
headlines.title_en: The Internet Broke Our Taste. Will A.I. Destroy It for Good?
headlines.event_summary_zh: 硅谷正将“品味”定义为AI时代区别于机器输出的核心竞争壁垒，引发关于人类审美判断力是否能被模型习得的深层辩论
headlines.event_summary_en: Silicon Valley is increasingly defining 'taste' as the ultimate human moat against generative AI's algorithmic slop. The current industry debate centers on whether aesthetic judgment is merely a pattern-matching exercise achievable by LLMs, or a uniquely human cognitive capability that determines future market valuation of creative output.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】硅谷科技创始人、投资者及工程技术人员在旧金山科技产业生态与公众舆论场：将“品味”确立为AI无法完全覆盖的核心差异化指标，并展开关于模型能否习得审美能力的博弈
【起因与机理】针对当前生成式AI产生的大量劣质内容（slop）及市场同质化危机所产生的焦虑与防御性思考
【关键技术规格】AI生成内容质量引发的审美危机与“slop”现象。
【各方立场与态度】人类审美能力是否为算法可学习模式的根本争论。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Silicon Valley founders, investors, and engineers: Positioning 'taste' as the core differentiator against AI, debating if models can eventually emulate human aesthetic judgment
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Anxiety over the proliferation of low-quality 'slop' and the potential erosion of human-unique creative value
[Key Metrics] In July, one such company, Mercor, was reportedly shelling out more than $4 million daily to 30,000 contractors.
[Key Position & Outlook] Fundamental debate over whether aesthetic judgment is algorithmic.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 将品味定义为“护城河”本质上是硅谷在高溢价内容市场对模型平庸化的防御性策略，若模型无法跨越审美的主观性壁垒，内容产业的底层逻辑将回归至‘人类策展+AI执行’的协作范式。长期看，这不仅关乎美学，更关乎在AI边际成本趋零的背景下，人类如何通过复杂的主观选择定义产品的溢价权。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Defining taste as a 'moat' is a strategic defense against the commoditization of AI-generated content. If models fail to bridge the subjectivity gap in aesthetics, the industry will pivot to a 'human curation + AI execution' paradigm, where human choice remains the primary determinant of price premiums in a zero-marginal-cost content ecosystem.

headlines.title_zh: Perplexity推出Monitor API支持自动化实时监控
headlines.title_en: Perplexity's new Monitor API turns web search from a one-off query into a nonstop watchdog
headlines.event_summary_zh: Perplexity发布Monitor API，通过自定义自然语言目标实现对全网及特定页面的自动化监控与智能筛选更新
headlines.event_summary_en: Perplexity has launched the Monitor API, allowing developers to define monitoring goals via natural language for periodic scanning of specific web pages or global information. The service integrates a decision model to filter out noise, pushing verified updates via webhooks only when findings meet predefined criteria for relevance, credibility, and novelty.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】困惑人工智能在企业开发者生态平台：发布Monitor API，支持全网查询监控与特定页面变更监测
【起因与机理】解决工程团队自行维护重复搜索代码及处理噪声信息的工程负担
【关键技术规格】企业级API通过自然语言定义任务，替代传统重复性爬虫代码。
【各方立场与态度】支持全网监控与特定URL变更比对，直接对标Firecrawl等存量市场玩家。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Perplexity AI (Enterprise developer ecosystem): Launch of Monitor API for web search and page change monitoring
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To alleviate the engineering overhead of building custom recurring search pipelines and noise reduction logic
[Key Metrics] Web monitors cost $1 per 1,000 successful runs, and page monitors cost $1 per 1,000 fetched URLs.
[Scope & Next Steps] Features include global search monitoring and targeted URL diffing to compete with incumbents like Firecrawl.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: Perplexity通过将底层搜索聚合能力封装为实时智能代理（Agentic）接口，试图从单纯的问答工具转型为企业的自动化情报基建。此举不仅对传统抓取服务供应商形成降维打击，更通过引入决策模型过滤层，进一步确立了其在AI应用链条中作为智能中枢的技术壁垒。
headlines.industry_impact_en: By encapsulating search aggregation into agentic APIs, Perplexity is pivoting from a consumer Q&A tool to a critical automation infrastructure. This move disrupts traditional scraping services and establishes a competitive moat by positioning itself as the intelligent middleware within the AI agentic workflow.

titans.quote_zh:
第一个块讲述了关于 @Hypesium 的更大故事，而不是简单的速度基准。

Elysium 以 100 毫秒的区块间隔运行，没有公共内存池。这改变了应用程序处理事务准备的方式。在传统的工作流程中，机会出现后可能会发生多个操作。在 Elysium 上，提前移动该工作成为一个重要的架构决策。

Hypesium 描述了一种准备优先的执行模型：

➜ 交易路径是提前构建的。
➜ Calldata 在池事件之前准备好。
➜ 气体信息被刷新。
➜ 维持钱包随机数状态。
➜ 池创建日志触发提交过程。

记录的热路径目标为 5 毫秒以下，并使用四个通信通道同时提交。

我发现有趣的是块时序和软件架构之间的关系。 100 毫秒的区块间隔不仅仅奖励更快的计算机。它还奖励那些最大限度地减少最后时刻剩余工作量的系统。

交易提交、区块包含和最终确认之间仍然存在区别。这些绝不应该被视为相同的性能测量。

@Hypesium 的架构提供了一个有趣的案例研究，将计算从时间敏感的执行窗口中移开。

真正的工程问题不仅仅是系统的反应速度有多快，而是在做出反应之前它完成了多少准备工作。
titans.quote_en:
The first block tells a bigger story about @Hypesium than a simple speed benchmark.

Elysium operates with 100ms block intervals and no public mempool. That changes the way applications need to approach transaction preparation. In a conventional workflow, several operations may happen after an opportunity appears. On Elysium, moving that work earlier becomes an important architectural decision.

Hypesium describes a preparation-first execution model:

➜ The transaction route is constructed in advance.
➜ Calldata is prepared before the pool event.
➜ Gas information is refreshed.
➜ Wallet nonce state is maintained.
➜ The pool creation log triggers the submission process.

The documented hot path targets under 5ms, with four communication lanes used for simultaneous submission.

What I find interesting is the relationship between block timing and software architecture. A 100ms block interval doesn't simply reward faster computers. It also rewards systems that minimize the amount of work left for the final moment.

There is still a distinction between transaction submission, block inclusion and final confirmation. These should never be treated as identical performance measurements.

@Hypesium's architecture offers an interesting case study in moving computation away from a time-sensitive execution window.

The real engineering question is not just how quickly a system reacts, but how much preparation it completes before there is anything to react to.

titans.event_context_zh:
划先于代码。

失败的测试先于修复。

每个更改都会由尚未了解其编写方式的上下文进行审查。

→ 规划：你给它一个句子并在一行出现之前批准该计划
→ 审阅：每种语言都有不同的审阅者，从头开始读取您的差异
→ 构建修复：每个工具链都有一个修复程序，包括 PyTorch 和 CUDA
→ 安全性：代理配置中的完整 OWASP 扫描和注入扫描
→ 架构：在迁移之前检测设计错误，当它们仍然便宜时
→ 领域：数据库、ML 管道、E2E 测试和文档

安全部分几乎没有人设置。

外部 OWASP 审核的费用为四位数和一周。这个在你吃之前已经准备好了。

这些技能涵盖测试、Python、Go、Rust、Django、Next.js、Docker 和 CI/CD。

也就是说，不要一次激活所有 286 个，否则您最终会得到一个比您原来的配置更糟糕的配置。

这是它很好地集成的方式：

→ 在复制任何内容之前创建一个 fork 并阅读 README
→ 仅从规划代理和您的主要语言的规则包开始
→ 仅将本周要使用的代理和技能复制到您的 .claude 文件夹
→ 随后添加代码审查人员和安全人员，因为它们产出最多
→ 首先在一个小型仓库上进行测试，而不是在生产环境中进行测试
→ 如果有多余的东西，就把它剪掉。如果您遗漏了什么，请再添加一件

规则很简单：如果您不知道代理的用途，那么您还不需要它。

谁在这个周末整合得好，谁就会在下个季度回顾工作而不是编写工作。

titans.quote_en:
THE WINNER OF ANTHROPIC'S OFFICIAL HACKATHON HAS PUBLISHED HIS CLAUDE CODE SETUP AND IT'S PURE GOLD

68 subagents, 286 skills, 94 commands, MIT license.

ECC turns Claude Code into a full engineering team.

The plan comes before the code.

The failing test comes before the fix.

Every change is reviewed by a context that hasn't seen how it was written.

→ Planning: you give it a sentence and approve the plan before a single line exists  
→ Review: a different reviewer per language that reads your diff from scratch  
→ Build fixes: a fixer per toolchain, including PyTorch and CUDA  
→ Security: full OWASP sweep and injection scanning in the agent config  
→ Architecture: detects design errors when they're still cheap, before migration  
→ Domain: databases, ML pipelines, E2E tests, and documentation

The security part is what almost nobody sets up.

An external OWASP audit costs four figures and a week. This one is ready before you eat.

The skills cover testing, Python, Go, Rust, Django, Next.js, Docker, and CI/CD.

That said, don't activate all 286 at once or you'll end up with a config worse than the one you had.

This is how it integrates well:

→ Make a fork and read the README before copying anything  
→ Start only with the planning agent and the rules pack for your main language  
→ Copy to your .claude folder only the agents and skills you're going to use this week  
→ Add the code reviewer and the security one afterward, as they yield the most  
→ Test it first on a small repo, not in production  
→ If something's extra, cut it. If you miss something, add just one more piece

The rule is simple: if you don't know what an agent is for, you don't need it yet.

Whoever integrates it well this weekend will spend the next quarter reviewing work instead of writing it.
